notes.title: Exciting News For Next Update
notes.content:
Hi, I have exciting news for the next update, that I decide to reduce the base price due to various feedback and the comparison of the game content. For the next update is going to be big, thus need more time as it drastically changes the way of the game experience. 

The next update is to bring combine the "planned" endgame content into the story itself so player can have more ways to play the game. This includes 

[list]
[*] Drastically change the equipment value, later the equip can bring more effect in the game.
[*] Adjust the story due to integrate with the new upcoming gameplay.
[*] Player will be able to setup the tower in each environment.
[*] Drastically improve the UI. Make it more user friendly and easier to access.
[/list]

These are the main upcoming changes to the game, and of course it comes with many more. 

Thank you for the feedback, they are very precious.

notes.title: 1 Month Anniversary
notes.content:
[h1]Thank You for 1 Month of Support! 🌟[/h1]

Dear Defenders,

We’re so grateful to celebrate 1 month since *Defense of Fort Burton* launched in Early Access! As a small indie team from Indonesia, your support means the world to us, and we’d love for more players to join our journey. 💖

[h3]Introducing Endless Mode (Beta)[/h3]
We’re thrilled to release the Endless Mode beta—a new endgame challenge where you can test your strategies against endless waves of enemies! This mode is still in development, and we’d love your feedback to make it even better. Try it out and let us know your thoughts in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/3183790/discussions/]Discussions[/url]

[h3]Celebrate with a 50% Off Sale[/h3]
To mark this milestone, we’re offering a limited-time 50% off sale from May 11 to May 25, 2025! Grab the game and join our growing community. We hope this small gesture helps more players experience Fort Burton’s hero synergies and magical spells.

[h3]Roadmap[/h3]
Together we also want to share our roadmap. This is all the plan for the next few months. Unfortunately we cannot provide the exact timeline, as we are very small indie dev and support and feedback is what we need the most to grow the game together. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45318216/6bd7f5ed9240571c2b1f6ca8d725ee586fe4372f.jpg[/img]

There are certains here we are currently making the progress are the 

[list]
[*] Endless mode, this is for each solo and have different environment to choose too
[*] Legendary of Fort Burton, this for unique experience in defending the Fort Burton while also help the town nearby to grow Fort.
[/list]

[h3]A Humble Request for Support[/h3]
If you enjoy the game, we’d be so thankful for your support—whether it’s a kind review, a wishlist, or sharing with friends. Every little bit helps our small team keep building this game we love. Thank you for being part of our journey!

[h3]Join as Defender of Fort Burton and support the journey![/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3183790/Defense_Of_Fort_Burton

Join our [url=https://discord.gg/nYQNFnA6Vc]Discord[/url] and follow us on [url=https://x.com/LedxFun]Twitter[/url] or [url=https://bsky.app/profile/ledxfun.com]Bluesky[/url]

With gratitude,
Edwin Jusuf

notes.title: Patch Notes Early Access v0.7.2.0
notes.content:
We are happy to announce a little teaser endgame content in this update. This opens for player to test out and give us some feedback of the endgame content. We fixed majority of annoying bugs especially with the UI

Here are the list.

[h2]New[/h2]
[list]
[*] Teaser of endgame content: Endless Mode - Lexy Solo.
[*] Added ability point cost on building the character. This returns more balance to each node of the character.
[*] Passive abilities are now granted by specific equipment.
[*] Added combo system for range fighters, allowing real-time build adjustments in battle.
[*] This combo detail is incoming on the next update.
[/list]
[h2]Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added shortcut views for map movement: Use A to move left and D to move right.
[*] Boss encounters have been rebalanced for a fairer challenge.
[*] Integrated Defense upgrade directly into the Character progression.
[*] Balance adjustments applied to various ability nodes.
[list]
[*] Reduced the damage area of the Explosion Arrow ability.
[*] Reduced the damage of the Focus Shot talent.
[/list]
[*] Balance updates implemented for several levels in the main story.
[list]
[*] Reduced the number of monsters appearing on Day 16.
[*] Rearranged the monster composition on Day 26.
[*] Reduced the number of monsters appearing on Day 27.
[*] Rearranged the monster composition on Day 29.
[/list]
[*] General balance updates applied to various monsters.
[*] Increased the cooldown of the Necromancer's Summon Undead ability.
[*] Balance update on fighters.
[list]
[*] Increased heal from healer by 10.
[*] Increased health by approximately 200 for all melee fighters.
[*] Increased defense for all melee fighters.
[/list]
[/list]
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the game could become stuck in the guide section.
[*] Fixed missing icons for certain buffs.
[*] Resolved issues where some ability nodes were not functioning correctly.
[*] Fixed a bug where the Tutorial section could appear twice.
[*] Corrected the UI appearance of the Wanderer.
[*] Fixed an issue where the UI was sometimes unresponsive, especially in the Preparation Phase.
[*] Fixed an issue where the UI sometimes froze for unknown reasons.
[*] Fixed the talent node for Lexy that reduces the Focus Shot cost.
[*] Fixed issues with some accessories not providing the correct stats.
[/list]

notes.title: Early Access Release
notes.content:
[h1]Defense of Fort Burton is OUT NOW in Early Access![/h1]

The gates are open, the heroes are ready, and the undead are knocking! [i]Defense of Fort Burton[/i] is officially available in Early Access on Steam, and we’re thrilled to invite you to join Howard, Lexy, and Albert in their epic stand to protect Fort Burton from waves of corrupted creatures and sinister undead forces!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45318216/021dfc0d67c7942449200dbae9115d2c3a150515.jpg[/img]

[h2]What is Defense of Fort Burton?[/h2] [i]Defense of Fort Burton[/i] is a side-scrolling tower defense game with a twist: you command three legendary heroes—[b]Howard the Warrior[/b], [b]Lexy the Archer[/b], and [b]Albert the Wizard[/b]—each with unique abilities that bring chaos to the battlefield. Build towers, set traps, and unleash magical spells to defend the fort’s population from relentless enemy waves. With a semi-realistic, cartoony art style and a gameplay flow that evolves from casual to brutally challenging, this is a tower defense adventure packed with fun, strategy, and heart.

[b]Core Features Available Now:[/b] 
[list] 
[*][b]Three Unique Heroes[/b]: Wield Howard’s frontline might, Lexy’s pinpoint archery, and Albert’s devastating magic to turn the tide of battle. 
[*][b]Strategic Tower Defense[/b]: Assign fighters like archers, mages, and priests to towers, upgrade defenses, and place traps to outsmart your enemies. 
[*][b]Dynamic Magic System[/b]: Collect magic points in battle to cast game-changing spells that adapt to your playstyle. 
[*][b]Main Story Campaign[/b]: Experience the prequel story of Fort Burton, where our heroes become legends in a world on the brink of darkness. 
[*][b]Population Scoring[/b]: Protect the fort’s citizens to earn high scores, with every life saved counting toward your victory. 
[/list]
[h2]Why Early Access?[/h2] We’re launching [i]Defense of Fort Burton[/i] in Early Access to build the best possible experience with [b]your[/b] help. The core game is packed with content: a full Main Story Campaign, three heroes with deep ability trees, and a robust defense system. But this is just the beginning! We’re a small team with big dreams, and Early Access lets us refine the game based on your feedback. Expect regular updates that add new content based on community input!

[b]Here’s what’s on the horizon:[/b] 
[list] 
[*][b]New Enemy Types[/b]: More undead horrors, and epic bosses. 
[*][b]Expanded Hero Customization[/b]: Additional equipment, talents, and passive abilities. 
[*][b]High-End Game Modes[/b]: Post-campaign challenges for veteran defenders. 
[*][b]Polish and Balance[/b]: Smoother gameplay, refined difficulty, and bug fixes. 
[/list]
[h2]Exclusive Rewards for Early Defenders![/h2] As a thank you for joining us during Early Access, all players who defend Fort Burton in this phase—our [b]Early Defenders[/b]—will gain access to [b]special endgame content[/b] once the game reaches its full release! We’re currently crafting this exclusive content, designed to reward your early support with unique challenges, rewards, and surprises that will enhance your journey. Stay tuned for more details as we continue to build this exciting addition!

[h2]Watch the Trailer![/h2] Get a taste of the action with our Early Access Launch Trailer below and see Howard’s ground-shattering strikes, Lexy’s explosive arrows, and Albert’s meteoric mayhem in glorious semi-cartoony style!

[previewyoutube=0hprCexoScw;full][/previewyoutube]

Now, grab your sword, nock your arrows, and summon your spells. Fort Burton needs you! ⚔️🏹✨

[h2]Join the Fight![/h2] We want [i]Defense of Fort Burton[/i] to be a game you love as much as we do. Jump into our [url=https://discord.gg/nYQNFnA6Vc]Discord[/url] to share your strategies, report bugs, or suggest new features. Your feedback will shape the future of Fort Burton! You can also follow us on [url=https://x.com/LedxFun]X/Twitter[/url] for updates and behind-the-scenes peeks.

[h3][b]Play Defense of Fort Burton Now![/b][/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3183790/Defense_Of_Fort_Burton

[h3]A Note from the Team[/h3] My name is Edwin Jusuf  and together with my friends as a small indie team, we’ve poured our hearts into [i]Defense of Fort Burton[/i]. This game is the prequel to a larger story in the Aeon Fantasy World, and we’re excited to share this chapter with you. There might be a few bumps along the way (undead sheep are tricky to wrangle!), but we’re committed to making this adventure epic. Thank you for joining us on this journey—your support means the world.

[i]With courage and gratitude,[/i]
Edwin Jusuf
Ledx

notes.title: Patch Notes Early Access v0.7.1
notes.content:
The first patch after the first early access release. Thank you for the feedback for the early defenders. As we announce here there are improvements and bug fixes.

Tell us what you think and any feedback is welcome!

[h3]New[/h3]
[list]
    [*] Achievements system is now available. More will be added in future patches.
    [*] Leaderboard system is now available. More will be added in future patches.
        [list]
            [*] Note: Both achievements and leaderboards are currently backend-only.
        [/list]
    [*] Guard system for melee fighters is now available. It functions like a "stand ground" mechanic.
[/list]

[h3]Improvements[/h3]
[list]
    [*] Overall performance has been optimized.
    [*] Effects have been adjusted to better match gameplay importance.
    [*] Lexy’s Focus Shot is now more responsive.
    [*] Balance update applied to Day 27 extra.
    [*] Reduced attack speed of skeleton archer.
    [*] Sphere monsters now have a chance to attack instead of always attacking.
    [*] Reduced mortar damage.
    [*] Added sound effects to several units.
[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
    [*] Fixed VFX for some abilities.
    [*] Fixed movement targeting issues with enemies.
    [*] Fixed descriptions for some abilities.
    [*] Fixed home UI appearances.
    [*] Fixed home UI descriptions.
    [*] Fixed missing icons for buffs or debuffs.
    [*] Fixed cursor behavior.
    [*] Fixed abilities for some bosses.
        [list]
            [*] Lich Queen now has proper visual ability and game mechanics.
            [*] Abomination has adjusted visualization.
        [/list]
    [*] Fixed issues with the wanderer not working properly.
        [list]
            [*] Fixed missing items for the wanderer.
            [*] Fixed appearance on specific days.
        [/list]
    [*] Fixed miscalculation of stats in the UI.
    [*] Fixed major issues with wrong appearances when selecting a unit.
    [*] Fixed quests that were not working properly.
[/list]
